newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman says buy BT up to 400p.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman says buy BT up to 400p.

text.p: Shares in British Telecom should be bought up to 400p following the planned merger with MCI Communications, analysts at Lehman Brothers said on Monday.
BT shares rose 22-1/2p to 373-1/2 on news of the merger plan in active trade of 82.4 million shares.

"Both management teams are arguing for extremely aggressive earnings numbers," Lehman said in a research note. "MCI in particular views low single figure earnings per share growth for BT as far too negative a forecast."

The note said executives from the two companies were arguing that they would achieve double the six percent rate of earnings per share growth suggested by current expectations of EPS growth for BT and MCI.

"The new Concert will grow EPS faster than old BT, our initial estimate is at least five percent faster," the note said, although BT's earnings per share will initially be diluted by the impact of the shares it is issuing to MCI investors.
